title: Opportunities For Talent: Workshopping The Foundations Of A Better Future
prompt: Build a collaborative brainstorm simulation inspired by Padlet workshops. The screen shows a shared sticky-note canvas; the player types a barrier phrase (e.g. 'cost', 'no industry contacts') and presses Enter to post it. An AI NPC educator then responds with a sticky-note solution that animates onto the board. Group the stickies into columns (Education / Industry / Government) by dragging. Playful classroom chalkboard aesthetic.
